shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'navigation|@gravity-ui/table|@gravity-ui/icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && sed -n '452,480p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider getRowSelectionColumn && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Modal Checkbox DropdownMenu Pagination Text Switch && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider getRowSelectionColumn && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Modal Checkbox DropdownMenu Pagination Text Switch && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -65'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
for term in ['House','Persons','ShoppingBag','Gear','Magnifier','Bell','CircleQuestion','ArrowDownToLine','Plus','ChevronDown','ChevronRight','ChevronLeft','BarsDescendingAlignLeft','Sliders','Layout','ArrowUpRight','ArrowRight','Calendar','CircleCheck','Clock','Truck','Xmark','Ellipsis','Envelope','ArrowRightFromSquare','CirclePlus','Layers','ChevronsLeft','ChartColumn']:
 print(term, bool(re.search(r'(?<"'![a-zA-Z])'"'+term+r'(?"'![a-zA-Z])'"',s)))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && sed -n '1,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'CSS|--gn|--g-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n -C 2 'getGroupTitle|rowClassName|headerCell|cellClassName' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/*.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(s=>{require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',s); console.log(s.slice(0,100)); console.log([...s.matchAll(/(?:House|Persons|Bag|Magnifier|Bell|CircleQuestion|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|ChevronLeft|Sliders|LayoutCells|ArrowUpRight|Calendar|CircleCheck|Clock|Truck|Xmark|Ellipsis|Layers)[A-Za-z]*/g)].map(x=>x[0]).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)===i).join(', '))})\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts && rg -n -C 1 'icon|counter|type MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n 'peerDependencies|react|bem-react' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | tail -10"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
print(s[s.find('magnifier')-100:s.find('magnifier')+200])
print(sorted(set(re.findall(r'[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+){0,4}',s)))[:30])
PY
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -15
sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css
rg -n 'CSS|--g-' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head -115 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n '1,45p;90,112p' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -95 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(House|Persons|Bag|Shopping|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|CircleQuestion|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|ChevronLeft|Sliders|Layout|ArrowUpRight|Calendar|CircleCheck|Clock|Truck|Xmark|Ellipsis|Layers|ArrowRight|ArrowRotate|CreditCard|CircleArrow|Circles|Person|CircleDollar)' | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.js | head -95 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -95"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRight|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|ChevronLeft|Bell|CircleQuestion|Calendar|CircleCheck|Clock|Truck|Check|ArrowRotateRight|Bars|CircleDollar)' | head -45 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts && sed -n '1,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js && rg -n -C 2 'color-text-(utility|positive|info|success)|color-base-(utility|positive|info|success)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light.scss | head -30 && sed -n '135,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Tr|Car|Box|Package|Circles|CircleQuestion)' | head -50 && rg -o --no-filename -- '--g-color-(text-(utility-heavy|light-primary|dark-primary|warning-heavy|positive)|base-(generic-ultralight|positive-medium|info-medium|utility-medium))' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u && sed -n '1,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -45 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'JS' const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('src/App.tsx','utf8').replaceAll('Truck','Car');s=s.replace('{statusLabel(row.original.status)}{row.subRows.length}','{statusLabel(row.original.status)}{row.subRows.length}');fs.writeFileSync('src/App.tsx',s);let css=fs.readFileSync('src/styles.css','utf8').replace('.group-content>.g-button>.g-button__text','.group-label');fs.writeFileSync('src/styles.css',css); JS npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseCell/BaseCell.css && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js && rg -n 'utility|text-light-primary|text-utility-heavy' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12 && cat vite.config.ts && rg --files | rg '(test|spec)' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg 'PageLayout.css"'$'"' && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js && rg -n -C 1 -- '--g-color-text-utility:|--g-color-text-utility-heavy:|--g-color-base-utility-light:|--g-color-text-light-primary:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20 && cat vite.config.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.js | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'JS'
const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('vitest.config.ts','utf8').replace(\"  plugins: [react()],\",\"  plugins: [react()],\\n  resolve: {alias: {'@gravity-ui/navigation': new URL('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js', import.meta.url).pathname}},\");fs.writeFileSync('vitest.config.ts',s);
JS
npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx --reporter=dot 2>&1 | tail -45"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'JS'
const fs=require('fs');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));pkg.scripts.test='vitest run';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\\n');
JS
npm run build"
